reviewer: Codex project AI cross-review agent /root/last_response_cross_review; not an independent human reviewer
method: Independent semantic cross review of all forty original replies and actual generated dialogue histories against the frozen exposed development cases/rubric. No ideal assistant injection; no other target reviews, reserved suite or model inference used. Boolean dimensions mark only score 1; additional dimensionScores and criterionScores preserve 0/0.5/1 judgments. criticalError records only concrete assertions judged incompatible with frozen facts or lacking basis; omissions and unintelligible text alone are not critical. Technical failures are recorded separately. Assessor also mechanically flags every positive discarded-token count; small system-only discards are distinguished from necessary dialogue-history loss.
criterionIdConvention: Rubric dimensions use their frozen IDs; per-turn semantic and critical IDs append .expected or .criticalExpected to the frozen case ID and refer to those exact source fields.
